headline: EBRD Maintains Romania Forecast: Economy to Contract 0.2% in 2026 and Grow 1.8% in 2027
summary: The EBRD maintained its forecasts for Romania, projecting a 0.2% economic decline in 2026 and 1.8% growth in 2027. The institution warns that risks to the outlook remain skewed to the downside.
why: The EBRD is a multilateral development bank that publishes regional economic forecasts used by investors assessing emerging European economies.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: BERD menține prognoza pentru România: economie în scădere cu 0,2% în 2026 și creștere de 1,8% în 2027
